queries:
WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id,
         c.town_city,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_stats AS (
  SELECT town_city,
         AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town_city
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio
  FROM town_stats
)
SELECT t.town_city,
       t.avg_price,
       t.avg_ratio,
       t.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_above_average
FROM town_stats t
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio;
WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id,
         c.town_city,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_avg AS (
  SELECT town_city,
         AVG(avg_price) AS town_avg_price,
         AVG(avg_ratio) AS town_avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town_city
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM item_town
)
SELECT t.town_city,
       t.town_avg_price,
       t.town_avg_ratio,
       t.town_avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_difference
FROM town_avg t, overall o
WHERE t.town_avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio;
WITH line AS (
  SELECT c.town_city AS town,
         ili.order_item_id AS order_item_id,
         ili.product_price AS price,
         ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
item_town AS (
  SELECT town, order_item_id, AVG(price) AS avg_price, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM line
  GROUP BY town, order_item_id
),
town_avg AS (
  SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM line
)
SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_difference
FROM town_avg t, overall o
WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio;
WITH line AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city AS town, ili.product_price,
         1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
item_town AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, town, AVG(product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM line
  GROUP BY order_item_id, town
),
town_avg AS (
  SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM town_avg
)
SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_above_average
FROM town_avg t, overall o
WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio;
